blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court has granted the defense’s move to cancel the scheduled trial on Friday since they no longer have a slated witness to testify that day. Lead defense counsel Sheila Sison made the request after both prosecution and defense agreed to dispense with the latter’s witness testimony on Thursday. READ: Prosecution seeks clarity on VP Duterte’s alleged dollar accounts “Since we no longer have witnesses for today and for the rest of the day and for tomorrow, we will just ask for the cancellation of tomorrow’s setting , and we’re okay with the court deducting that trial date from our requested trial date, Your Honor,” Sison said.
